intelligence.economy_brief: The OSRS market is in a normal patch window with subdued price pressure and elevated breadth. Turnover is modestly positive while liquidity stress remains elevated, and the shallowest book depth is concentrated in high-spread, low-volume names.
intelligence.market_mood: Cautious and range-bound; participants are prioritizing cost of entry and fill probability over aggressive reversion, producing low-volatility, low-alpha conditions.
intelligence.regime: Normal patch window (not an update cycle); deterministic news flow is quiet, macro/microstructure metrics indicate a compressed risk-appetite regime.
intelligence.research_summary: Deterministic setup implies price discovery is rule-driven; cross-wallet edges arise from differential risk-budgeting and microstructure timing rather than exogenous news. Current regime favors strategies with tight spread capture, low inventory risk, and high fill probability.
intelligence.summary: Breadth is slightly positive (5.9% advancers) but turnover-weighted pressure is near flat. Market depth is thin and spread dispersion is high, with the thinnest liquidity in lower-tier items. Book conditions favor patient, liquidity-weighted execution; the frontier lab runs a high-risk experimental sleeve while the market maker and velocity wallets pursue carry-and-flow scalps.
watchlist: Twisted bow (top turnover, tight spread; watch for depth erosion)

assumptions: Read-only replay; never touches live wallet state.
Uses 1-hour Wiki bars, so 5-minute flow is approximated from hourly volume and trailing activity.
Passive fills remain the deterministic expected-fill model used by the paper engine; this is diagnostic, not a claim about real GE queue fills.
The LLM semantic prior is disabled in replay so strategy diagnostics remain deterministic and reproducible.
The usual weekly update-window prior is evaluated at each historical replay timestamp rather than using the current live clock.
Universe is bounded to currently relevant/high-activity items, so results are a strategy diagnostic rather than an exhaustive historical backtest.
